notes.page_summary: The page continues the claim that the homotopy type can be reconstructed through its fundamental infinity-groupoid, including all cohomological operations in the system of n-categories. It then proposes a similarly perfect correspondence for more structured homotopy types associated with finite diagrams and stratifications of moderate topological spaces, using (n+1)-categories of n-champs constant on strata. In conditional language it anticipates recovery of a mixed homotopy type from an indicated subcategory of a derived category together with tensor and Hom operations. The visible text ends mid-sentence at le/les.
